claims: For an unforced unit-viscosity distribution NS pair with u in L-infinity_t L2_x intersect L2_t H1_x and p in L^(3/2) on Q1, a fixed local solenoidal extension and div-curl Hardy estimate give integral_{B3/4 x (-1,0)} |Hess p| <= C(E+D^(2/3)). No local energy inequality is needed for this a priori estimate.

Spatial mollification of one fixed weak solution preserves G_epsilon=grad u_epsilon. The exact divergence-free transport commutator has a product of velocity and gradient increments and tends to zero in local L1 by the (2,2)-to-1 estimate and translation continuity of fixed G in L2.

For fixed spatial epsilon the fully convolved equation gives an absolutely continuous time representative. A nonnegative cutoff preserves the top gradient-norm slice. Convex norm regularization, then zero-set truncation of the compatible shape variable, then epsilon-to-zero identify Theta(G)=d(G)G/|G|^(3/2), zero at G=0, in the whole interior L2_t H1_x space.

The local bound is esssup_{-1/4<t<0} integral_{B1/2}|grad u| + integral_{Q1/2}|grad Theta|^2 <= C[sqrt(E)+sqrt(AE)+E+D^(2/3)]. It also gives local Theta in L-infinity_t L2_x. Separate nonnegative budgets are added with their constant factors, not counted twice against one unchanged bound.

For a suitable weak pair near closure Q1, a larger mother cylinder or finite interior covering supplies the full Theta weak derivative required by frozen SC-A. Its conditional regularity implication therefore needs no additional Theta-H1 assumption; the same epsilon_Theta(M) still requires actual smallness and a common A+E+D cap.

Under NS scaling K(r/2) <= C[sqrt(E(r))+sqrt(A(r)E(r))+E(r)+D(r)^(2/3)], where K(r)=r^(-1) integral_{Qr}|grad Theta|^2. This is only a finite critical bound. The exact smooth local entropy balance retains signed pressure-inertia, transport, cutoff and slice terms and gives no contraction by itself.

limitations: An arbitrary actual NS evolution has not been shown to produce a prescribed-centre scale with a common A+E+D cap and normalized Theta-gradient below epsilon_Theta(M).
No cross-scale contraction, non-summable disjoint concentration cost, or automatic o(r) entropy dissipation follows from the finite local or global estimates.

The signed pressure-inertia combination and cutoff transport in the exact local entropy balance are not controlled by a sufficiently small critical quantity. Ordinary backward heat kernels do not remove them; an advective adjoint requires its own uniform local lower-bound proof.

No classical rough-solution Gamma=|G||grad(G/|G|)|^2 or full radial grad|G| is defined or controlled here, and no signed zero-set defect is identified. The accepted object is the full weak derivative of Theta.
Effective thresholds, regularity-radius moduli, optimality, a full source-collision/novelty audit and human peer review remain outstanding.
General three-dimensional global regularity, a singularity construction and the Clay goal remain open.
Participating AI review is not human peer review or a complete novelty certification.
